scene: The tipped lucky cat winks, revealing three transit gates across the plaza.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a multi-platform transit plaza. Far left hangs an open glass cable pod on a glowing wire. Left, the player stands on roller skates holding a lucky copper token. Centre sits a sleek pink bullet train at a platform. Right, a glowing destination board shows three routes. Far right, a wooden solar-sail junk bobs at a dock.
shown: a dangling round glass cloud cable pod door waiting open far left
a sleek pink bullet train with doors sliding open at centre
a wooden solar-sail junk moored at a dock far right
